brand.name: Whispero Nepal

buttons.primary: bg-[#E63946] text-white hover:bg-[#D62828] active:scale-95 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(230,57,70,0.3)]

inputs.text: bg-[#0F0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E63946] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E63946]/50 transition-all text-base
inputs.capsule_chat: bg-[#1A1010] border border-white/10 rounded-full px-5 py-3 text-white placeholder-white/40 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#FFB703] w-full

chat_bubbles.sender: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#E63946] to-[#D62828] text-white p-4 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm self-end max-w-[85%] shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(230,57,70,0.2)]
chat_bubbles.receiver: bg-[#1A1010] border border-white/5 text-white/90 p-4 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm self-start max-w-[85%]

bottom_nav.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/90 border-t border-white/5 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center max-w-md mx-auto h-[72px]

category_tabs.container: flex overflow-x-auto gap-3 py-3 px-4 no-scrollbar border-b border-white/5
category_tabs.tab: whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-2 rounded-full border font-medium text-sm transition-all

modals.content: bg-[#0F0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl
modals.report_modal: bg-[#0F0A0A] border border-[#E63946]/20 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(230,57,70,0.1)] text-white

badges.trending: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FFB703] to-[#FB8500] text-[#050505] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with subtle 10px slide up (Framer Motion or standard CSS)
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton pulse matching the #1A1010 surface color

testing.required_attributes: All buttons, inputs, category tabs, and interactive elements MUST have a unique data-testid matching kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='tab-trending')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly non-destructive update. DO NOT change any core state variables, React Context structures, or API fetching logic.
Update classNames in /app/frontend/src/components/ to match these design guidelines.
Ensure `lucide-react` is used for all iconography, sized correctly (usually w-5 h-5 or w-6 h-6).
Replace the old blue/purple theme on ReportModal to match the moody ruby/amber dark theme.
Ensure the entire app is wrapped in the mobile-first constraint layout (`max-w-md mx-auto`) with proper safe-area padding for the bottom navigation.
Update index.css to configure Tailwind variables if necessary, but prioritize standard utility classes.
Remove any remaining flat white/gray themes and thoroughly enforce the warm dark mode across all views (Home, Stranger Chat, Trending, Alerts).
Inject `data-testid` properties to every single clickable UI element.
Always maintain accessibility: Focus states must have `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E63946]` or similar visible rings.
